item.title: Man dies in trailer fire
item.description: HELPER — Just before 7:30 p.m. on Wednesday, Jan. 14, a man died in a trailer fire in Helper. The Helper City Police and Fire Departments responded to a call about a structure fire, and when they arrived on scene the trailer was fully engulfed in flames. item.title: Elmo has a new mayor
item.description: ELMO – At Elmo Town’s Jan. meeting on Tuesday the 13, town clerk Gabrielle Brotherson issued the oath of office to Tim Downard. Downard will now serve the town of Elmo as Mayor. Following the swearing in, the council approved adding Downard and Brotherson to all bank accounts and removing James Winn and Delena Fish.
